notes.title: Update 1.4: Local Co-op, Optimization, New Voiceover & More!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, everyone![/p][p align="start"][/p][previewyoutube="hGCD85sUYcg;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"]We've just deployed a major update that makes [b]KIBORG[/b] even better. As always, a huge thank you for your continued support and feedback—it was instrumental in shaping this list of changes.[/p][h3][b]🎮 Key Improvements in This Update:[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]🛋️ Local Couch Co-op (via Steam Remote Play Together)[/b]
The highly requested feature is here! You can now experience the game's story with a friend on the same screen. While it's local co-op, you can easily invite a friend to play online using [b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b]. Grab a couch and get ready for some shared adventures![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44057409/8a6d8cce61b8dc332811c8e8a02a45327fd1d0b6.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]✨ Significant UI Polish[/b]
We've done a major visual overhaul of the game's user interface. All elements remain in their familiar places (we didn't change the UX), but they now look much more detailed, stylish, and atmospheric. We hope you enjoy the new visual flair![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44057409/afd9107e4a414e19954a2e7de570343e240d7573.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]⚡ Major Performance Optimization (CPU)[/b]
We performed a deep code refactoring that significantly reduces the game's CPU load. This is especially noticeable in large levels and scenes with many objects. [i]Note: If your performance was previously limited by your graphics card (GPU), you may not see a drastic FPS boost, but overall stability should be improved.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]🎙️ New Narrator Voiceover (Optional)[/b]
We've recorded an alternative voiceover for the main narrator in English. This is an option for those who, for whatever reason, would prefer a different delivery. [b]It's important to note:[/b] We still consider the original voice to be the canonical one and we love it, but we are listening to our community and want to ensure everyone can find the most comfortable experience. The new voice can be selected in the sound settings.[/p][p align="start"][b]📢 New Announcer Lines[/b]
The narrator has become a bit more talkative! We've added several new lines that may hint at some story details and immerse you deeper into the game's atmosphere. Don't worry, we've avoided spoilers—just some light and intriguing hints.[/p][p align="start"][b]🎬 Intro Video for New Players[/b]
To better introduce new players to the game's world, we've added a cinematic intro video that plays when starting a new game. We took it from our launch trailer, so it won't be new content for our veterans, but it will perfectly set the tone for newcomers.[/p][p align="start"][b]🐞 Numerous Bug Fixes[/b]
As with any major update, we've squashed a bunch of small and not-so-small bugs to make your gameplay even smoother and more enjoyable.[/p][p]For example fixed chain attack widget stuck on screen[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]We hope you enjoy these changes! As always, we'd love to hear your feedback in the comments below.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for playing [b]KIBORG[/b]![/p][p align="start"][i]Your Sobaka Studio team.[/i][/p]

tags.feature: The highly requested feature is here! You can now experience the game's story with a friend on the same screen. While it's local co-op, you can easily invite a friend to play online using [b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b]. Grab a couch and get ready for some shared adventures!

We've done a major visual overhaul of the game's user interface. All elements remain in their familiar places (we didn't change the UX), but they now look much more detailed, stylish, and atmospheric. We hope you enjoy the new visual flair!

We performed a deep code refactoring that significantly reduces the game's CPU load. This is especially noticeable in large levels and scenes with many objects. [i]Note: If your performance was previously limited by your graphics card (GPU), you may not see a drastic FPS boost, but overall stability should be improved.[/i]

We've recorded an alternative voiceover for the main narrator in English. This is an option for those who, for whatever reason, would prefer a different delivery. [b]It's important to note:[/b] We still consider the original voice to be the canonical one and we love it, but we are listening to our community and want to ensure everyone can find the most comfortable experience. The new voice can be selected in the sound settings.

The narrator has become a bit more talkative! We've added several new lines that may hint at some story details and immerse you deeper into the game's atmosphere. Don't worry, we've avoided spoilers—just some light and intriguing hints.

To better introduce new players to the game's world, we've added a cinematic intro video that plays when starting a new game. We took it from our launch trailer, so it won't be new content for our veterans, but it will perfectly set the tone for newcomers.

notes.title: Hot fix
notes.content:
Quick patch for some annoying issues!
[list]
[*] Fixed endless scores from enemy kills after resuming the game.
[*] Fixed endless scores UI not updating properly after completing a room.
[*] Fixed meditation-like event screens not responding correctly to gamepad input.
[*] Fixed a bug where declining a mutation increased negative effects. It now increases only positive effects.
[*] Fixed Gunslinger legs — they now properly drop ammo from AoE melee attacks.
[*] Fixed Reaper IV mutation not increasing attack speed as intended.
[/list]
Thanks for sharing faced issues with us

tags.bug: - Fixed endless scores from enemy kills after resuming the game.
- Fixed endless scores UI not updating properly after completing a room.
- Fixed meditation-like event screens not responding correctly to gamepad input.
- Fixed a bug where declining a mutation increased negative effects. It now increases only positive effects.
- Fixed Gunslinger legs — they now properly drop ammo from AoE melee attacks.
- Fixed Reaper IV mutation not increasing attack speed as intended.

notes.title: Another Great Patch
notes.content:
[h1]🛠️ Patch Notes[/h1]
🎮[b] Steam Deck Verified![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44057409/7c76ea8e2ed9874ba69145555eaeb170aab28466.jpg[/img]

Kiborg is now officially Steam Deck Verified!
To achieve this milestone, we’ve significantly improved the Steam Deck interface and enhanced text readability throughout the game.

[h2]🐞 Major Bug Fix[/h2]
Fixed a critical bug that caused the game to crash when pressing "Play Game." Enjoy a smoother experience!

[h2]⚡ Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]Blur[/h3]
[list]
[*] Secondary stats now provide more speed: 5% → 10%
[*] Fire damage bonus from attack chain increased: 0.1% → 0.3%
[*] Slow motion from Blur Spine reduced: 40/50/60/70% → 20/25/30/40%
[*] Attack chain duration bonus from major synergy increased: +1s → +3s
[/list]
[h3]Fenrir[/h3]
[list]
[*] Altars now count all deaths in the zone.
[/list]
[h3]Gunslinger[/h3]
[list]
[*] Knives from the left hand now travel farther, no longer getting stuck mid-air, and reliably fly toward walls.
[/list]
[h3]Source[/h3]
[list]
[*] Source implants now grant stronger bonuses when combined with other implants.
[*] Increased ally damage.
[*] Implant base bonus to ally level increased: 1 → 2.
[/list]
[h3]Thundergod[/h3]
[list]
[*] Thunderstorm Attractor augmentation now summons lightning instead of just buffing it.
[*] Free Spark now has a new effect: Restores 10% of battery after killing an enemy.
[/list]
[h3]Remedium[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed health bonus from Remedium secondary stats.
[*] Right Hand poison buildup from attacks increased: 10 → 40
[*] Left Hand poison buildup from blocking increased: 20 → 40
[/list]
Dev Comment: Remedium was too tanky without meaningful early-game damage options. These changes provide more offensive tools earlier in the game.

[h3]Guardian[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the outdated part of the minor synergy:
    “You receive positive status effects of your allies, while allies receive yours.”

[*] New major synergy effect:
    Each shield increases melee damage by 1%. This bonus increases by 1% per shield.
[/list]
Dev Comment: These changes remove outdated effects and introduce much-needed late-game damage scaling for the set.

[h3]Sovereign[/h3]
[list]
[*] Swapped the effects of the minor and major synergies.
[/list]
[h2]⚔️ Combat[/h2]
Dash attack damage reduced.
Combo attack damage increased for:
[list]
[*] Ankhil
[*] Balmung
[*] Gáe Bolg
[*] Gan Jiang
[*] Mjölnir
[*] Kusanagi
[/list]
Dev Comment: We want to keep dash attacks primarily as movement tools while rewarding players for engaging in close combat and executing combos.

[h2]👾 Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] Disabled Loader’s gravity pull attack to prevent softlocks.
[*] Chemist explosion now has a trigger chance; radius and timing adjusted.
[*] Incubator projectile now travels faster, but is less magnetic to targets.
[/list]
[h2]🛠️ Weapon Mods[/h2]
Death Bonus effect reduced: 3% → 1%
Fortune Matrix nerfed: 0.25/0.5/0.75/1% per token → 0.1/0.2/0.3/0.4%
Disabled the following melee mods:
[list]
[*] Awaken Rage
[*] Awaken Defense
[*] Awaken Blood
[*] Awaken Life
[*] Awaken Symbiosis
[*] Transcend Rage
[*] Transcend Defense
[*] Transcend Blood
[*] Transcend Life
[*] Transcend Symbiosis
[/list]
Dev Comment: These mods cluttered loot drops and had minimal impact. Disabling them improves the overall quality of high-rarity weapons.

[h2]⚠️ Traps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Laser: lasts longer, moves slower, deals more damage.
[*] Flamethrower: duration increased.
[*] Hand trap: more accurate, hits for longer.
[/list]
Dev Comment: These changes improve clarity and fairness when dealing with traps.

[h2]🔧 Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implant primary stats (such as shields from Guardian or energy from Thundergod) are now unlocked from the beginning of the game.
[*] Ammo Drops perk is nerfed: 15 ammo → 10 ammo
[*] Enemy level increased in stages 2 and 3 on difficulties 6 and 7
[*] Smoothed difficulty curve between floor 1 end and floor 2 middle
[*] The Second Wind super attack is now locked until the beginning of the first fight
[*] Russian Roulette can no longer kill the player and now leaves them at 1 health instead
[*] Safe rewards adjusted:
    - Tokens: 150 → 120
    - Ammo: 150 → 100
[*] Player now repels allies when moving
[*] Increased max FOV for ultra-wide screens
[*] New UI for the start and end of combat animations 
[*] Soldiers now have an alternative model
[/list]
[h2]🎬 Animations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated block-break animations for several enemies
[*] Tweaked knife attack animations
[*] New dismemberment death animations
[*] Updated animation for Agent Fenrir
[*] Improved asteroid visuals and animation
[*] Polished heavy sword animations
[*] Updated Lancer visual effects
[/list]
[h2]🧰 Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed damage types for Generator Protocol, Golden Rod, and Thunderdome augmentations
[*] Fixed Thunderdome math calculations
[*] Fixed critical hits on heavy hitters
[*] Fixed Prevention Wearout weapon mod
[*] Fixed several localization bugs
[*] Fixed spike dodge behavior
[*] Whisper Arena intro lighting now only plays once
[*] Prevented players from getting stuck on traps
[*] Fixed secondary explosions from Ki Explosion harming allies
[*] Trap decals now properly appear beneath traps
[*] Ammo on Demand perk no longer drops duplicate boxes
[*] Fixed an issue where the suicide bot loader could use gravity pull
[*] Fixed Mine Launcher spawning all mines in one place
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the Long-Term Investment mutation from appearing at the beginning of the run.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Patch & Future Plans!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

We’ve just released a major patch packed with fixes (details below), and now we’d like to share our current plans and thoughts with you!

MAC build and Consoles will be updated in nearest future!

1. [b]Thank You![/b]
First of all — a huge thank you for your time spent in the game, your feedback, bug reports (especially via F7!), and for the amazing content on YouTube, Twitch, and other platforms! You make our community better!

2. [b]What We’re Working On Right Now[/b]

[list]
[*] Endless Mode and 6 new arenas — both features are already in development and will be released in just a couple of weeks!
[*] Steam Trading Cards — waiting for final approval from Valve.
[*] Steam Deck — actively working on compatibility improvements to get that sweet verification.
[*] Soundtrack and ArtBook — will be released soon separatly!
[/list]

3. [b]Co-op — Is It Happening?[/b]
We did experiment with local co-op in one of the demo versions, but the game has since become more complex. Just imagine: two players in full "Source" armor means 14 units on the battlefield at once! 😅
Still, we’re exploring the possibility of adding co-op in some limited form. But it’s important to note: online co-op is definitely not happening — it’s technically impossible in "KIBORG".

4. [b]Voice Acting — What’s the Plan?[/b]
We know many of you aren’t happy with the current voice acting. In this patch, we’ve added the option to disable character voices individually. We’re also looking into ways to improve this further, but we’re not ready to share details yet.

5. [b]Discord & Leaderboards?[/b]
We’re considering adding Discord activities (maybe tournaments or events) and a leaderboard system — but these are still in early discussions.

6. [b]Secret Ideas…[/b]
We have some really exciting ideas in the works, but it’s too early to talk about them. Once things are finalized, we’ll share the news — promise it’ll be worth the wait! 🔥

[h1]Full list of patch notes[/h1]
[h2]Gameplay changes[/h2]

Status effect tick damage can no longer kill the player — it no longer deals damage when the player has 1 health.
Dev Comment: Dying from status effects was one of the most frustrating experiences. With this change, status effects should feel fairer to players.

Status explosions now deal more damage to enemies.

Enemies now have higher levels on difficulties 2 through 7, providing a more engaging challenge.

Adjusted the difficulty curve at the end of Floor 2 and the beginning of Floor 3 to smooth out a difficulty spike.

The "Organic Tissue" augmentation now heals from the last two hits instead of three.

Removed the "Efficient Exchange" perk.
Dev Comment: "Organic Tissue" and "Efficient Exchange" rewarded passive gameplay, such as standing AFK out of combat. This created unengaging playstyles, so we’re addressing this issue in this and the next patch.

Buffed the following mutators:
- Brawler
- Patience
- Defensive Overcharge
- Berserker Rage
- The Last Light
- Glass Cannon
- Bloodhunt
- Tesla Adept
- Energy Surge
- Status Overload
- Bladerunner
- Glassforged
- Digital Mirage I
- Digital Mirage II
- Digital Mirage III
- Reaper III
- Reaper IV
- Reaper VI
- Reaper VII
- Deadeye II
- Deadeye III
- Deadeye V
- Aegis Shield System III
- Aegis Shield System IV
- Steelblood IV
Dev Comment: Mutators should now feel like real power boosts instead of unfavorable trade-offs.

Removed "Elite Bodyguards" mutator until further rework.

Slightly increased the reload cost of the Gauss Revolver.

Nerfed Gunslinger augmentations:
- Quick Reload
- Quick Draw
- Full Metal Jacket
- One Machine Army
Dev Comment: These high-end augmentations were a bit too strong and made the Gunslinger overpowered too quickly. The set can still reach a "broken" state, but now it won’t escalate as fast and won’t one-shot the final boss.

Reduced number of Drone Factories and Incubators in encounters.

Fenrir Minor Synergy now has an increased chance to drop health pickups.

Fenrir altars now drop melee weapon pickups instead of health packs.
Dev Comment: These Fenrir changes should make the set more stable and less dependent on RNG for melee weapon drops.

Reduced horizontal recoil deviation; overall recoil on some weapons has been lowered.

Removed the "Integrator" melee weapon mod.

Blur Heart now requires a smaller attack chain to trigger healing.

[h2]⚙️ IMPROVEMENTS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chemist Balloon Explosion – Updated logic for more predictable chaos
[*] Enemy AI Tweak – Attack commitments! Enemies can no longer swap targets mid-swing
[*] Weapon Recoil 2.0 – Smoother shooting physics
[*] HUD Upgrade – Critical info now bigger & bolder
[*] Reset Progress – Added hold-to-confirm (no more tragic misclicks)
[*] Cutter Abilities – Rebalanced weight system
[*] Steam Deck – Disabled annoying feedback hints
[/list]

[h2]🐞 BUG FIXES:[/h2]
Cinematic Safety
[list]
[*]  Fixed deaths during safe cutscenes
[*]  Turrets no longer fire during dramatic moments
[/list]
Progress Blockers
[list]
[*]  Meditation softlock erased
[*]  Negative max health glitch patched
[/list]
Annoyances Removed
[list]
[*]  Duplicate notifications silenced
[*]  Inga’s repeated phrases reduced
[*]  Roulette spin after reward fixed
[/list]
Text & UI
[list]
[*]  Incorrect descriptions rewritten
[*]  Super Strike gamepad hint corrected
[*]  Implant upgrade stats now display properly
[/list]
Balance & Behavior
[list]
[*]  Universal Remedium regeneration fixed
[*]  Equilibrium perk won’t harm allies anymore
[*]  Dual Heatstorm sidearms stats recalibrated
[/list]
Character Issues
[list]
[*]  Novak no longer eternally stuck in "Saint Mode"
[*]  Whisper no longer stuck after Dead
[*]  Gunslinger drones don't stugger bosses
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

Thank you for your incredible enthusiasm and positive feedback on Kiborg! We’re rolling out the first hotfix patch—intentionally keeping it focused on fixes rather than big changes to avoid unexpected issues. Many of these adjustments were originally planned for the release but are finally making their way in now.

Moving forward, we’ll keep polishing and improving the game, and yes—we’re also preparing free additional content for those of you who want EVEN MORE! Stay tuned, and thanks for your support!

[b]Major Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added end credits
[*] Fixed video cutscenes for difficulty levels 6 and 7
[*] Corrected soundtracks for video cutscenes
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed Linked Armor augmentation
[*] Fixed Iron Fist and Ki Explosion not penetrating Lancer’s shield
[*] Fixed music disappearing when exiting the arena
[*] Fixed Sovereign features being incorrectly disabled with the Brawler mutation (which disables ranged weapons)
[*] Fixed Defective Implants mutation affecting couriers
[*] Fixed issues with ranged weapon mods and upgrades for the Gunslinger’s right-hand revolver
[*] Fixed sidearm selection screen for the Gunslinger’s right-hand revolver
[/list]

[b]Small Improvements[/b]

[list]

notes.title: Prepare for the Beatdown! KIBORG Release Date Revealed + New Trailer!
notes.content:
Hey Brawlers!
We're beyond thrilled to finally announce the official release date for Kiborg! Mark your calendars for April 30! Get ready to dive into the chaotic world of The Last Ticket Show and unleash your inner fighter.
To celebrate this momentous occasion, we've also dropped a brand-new release date trailer! Get a glimpse of the brutal challenges that await you.

Watch the Release Date Trailer Here: [previewyoutube=Yk-nwn4YLYA;full][/previewyoutube]

Morgan Lee has been accused of war crimes he didn’t commit and sentenced to a 1,300-year sentence on the galaxy’s worst prison planet with no hope of parole. Death provides no escape, as his jailors will keep reviving him until he serves every last second. But one way out does exist: win on Cable Galactica’s hottest game show, “The Last Ticket".

In Kiborg, you'll:
[list]
[*] Fight your way through procedurally generated arenas: No two runs are ever the same!
[*] Try a variety of unique implants: Each with their own fighting enhancement and abilities.
[*] Unleash devastating combos and special abilities: Dominate your foes with style.
[*] Collect powerful items and upgrades: Adapt your build to survive the onslaught.
[*] Face challenging enemies: Test your skills against formidable foes.
[*] And much more!
[/list]

We've poured our hearts and souls into creating a roguelike beat-'em-up that delivers intense action, replayability, and a whole lot of fun. We can't wait for you to experience it!

[b]Don't forget to wishlist Kiborg on Steam to stay updated and be notified the moment it launches![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2405060

Thank you for your incredible support throughout development. We're counting down the days until you can join the fight!
See you in the coming season of “The Last Ticket”!
